# Pitoo

> A free, open source desktop code editor for Mac (Apple Silicon), Windows and Linux. It works with no internet, no account and no AI. An AI agent is optional: a local model through MLX, Ollama or LM Studio, or your own Anthropic or OpenAI key. Pitoo was called Anvil before version 0.4.0.
